content.question: What is the key difference between stochastic and batch gradient descent?
options: Batch gradient descent updates the parameters after the entire dataset iteration, while SGD updates them after one or a small random mini-batch of records.
SGD updates the parameters only after the entire dataset iteration, while batch gradient descent uses mini-batches.
Batch gradient descent never converges, while SGD always finds the global minimum.
SGD can only be applied to low-dimensional problems.
content.answer: Batch gradient descent updates the parameters after the entire dataset iteration, while SGD updates them after one or a small random mini-batch of records.
